{{Quote|The new Count, Bron Dooku, is too young to assume rule so a regent must be appointed. Normally it would go to a member of his immediate family, but there is no one. Mother and father both dead. The other Counts -- the heads of the other five Great Houses -- will meet. One of them will be appointed regent. The decision must be unanimous. Our interests lay with the head of House Borgin -- ''Rodas Borgin''. You are to do whatever is necessary to insure he is named regent.|Armand Isard, to Agent Jahan Cross|<ref name="AotEpt6" />}}
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], a '''conclave''' was held by the various [[Noble/Legends|noble]] houses of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] to appoint a [[Regent/Legends|regent]] ruler to rule in [[Bron Dooku]]'s place until he came of age; as an official Imperial envoy, [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Jahan Cross]] of the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] was naturally invited to attend these normally highly exclusive discussions. Though assigned to ensure [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Rodas Borgin]]'s appointment as regent, Cross took it upon himself to protect the child of the man he himself killed. The main negotiator at the meetings was Cross's father, [[Davim Cross]], who was skeptical of Jahan's supposed non-involvement with the death of [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku.<ref name="AotEpt7">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 2|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 2]]</ref>

The next round of meetings took place aboard the Dooku airship, the [[Windrunner/Legends|''Windrunner'']]. In the midst of negotiations, the airship was [[Attack on the Windrunner|attacked]] by a pirate airship known as the ''[[Bloodskull]]''. Commanded by [[Aveca Dunn|Vex]], operating under the employment of Rodas Borgin, the pirates attempted to capture Bron Dooku.<ref name="AotE8:HT3">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 3|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 3]]</ref>
